The '''Ordinance''' [''sic''] '''Research Division''' was a division of the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] that was based at the [[Maw Installation]], an [[Imperial research center]] in the midst of the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]], a virtually unnavigable cluster of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]]. The Ordinance Research Division was headed by [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Golanda]].

==Behind the scenes==
Though this is clearly a facility that researches ordnance, not ordinances, the term "ordinance" is used in the division's name in the Maw Installation Organizational Chart on page 71 of ''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''. Page 73 uses the correct term when it mentions the [[Imperial Ordnance Research Facility]] and Ordnance Research and Development.
